async def run(items, operation, configured):
    # ruleid: serial-bounded-helper-python
    await map_with_concurrency(items, 1, operation)
    # ruleid: serial-bounded-helper-python
    await pool.map_with_concurrency(items, operation, width=1)
    width = 1
    await map_with_concurrency(items, width, operation)
    await map_with_concurrency(items, operation, width=width)
    await map_with_concurrency(items, configured, operation, 1)
    await map_with_concurrency(items, operation, 1)
    # ruleid: serial-bounded-helper-python
    await map_with_concurrency(items, 1, operation, 4)
